text:
Alex W: Heads up — PR #12121 is blocked from merging. CI queue is backed up and one integration shard failed repeatedly (shard-7).

Priya R: Which test is failing on shard-7? any logs or snapshot diffs?

Alex W: Fail log snippet: ```
FAIL tests/test_routing.py::test_prefix_cache_timeout
E   AssertionError: expected 0 but got 1
...
Timed out waiting for KV sync after 30s
```

CI Bot: Job 12121.7 failed on integ/shard-7 (timeout). Retry available: `/rebuild 12121.7` 

Sam: If the queue is saturated, a straight retry might wait behind other jobs. We can promote this to a high-priority slot for a single rerun. @Taylor can you allocate?

Taylor: I can carve out a priority slot — will do if we have a good signal this is flaky and not a real regression. Priya, can you +1 to approve a quick rerun once Alex pushes a minimal fix?

Priya R: I can review and +1. Can we avoid pushing a snapshot change unless it's intentional? Looks like a timing flake.

Alex W: Agreed on avoiding snapshots. Pushed a quick CI-only patch to add a short retry in test: `pytest.mark.flaky(reruns=2)` and a comment linking to issue #458. No production code changes.

Sam: Good. Taylor, please trigger the high-priority rerun after that patch lands.

Taylor: Triggered high-priority rerun: `/rebuild 12121.8 --priority=high` — CI Bot gave the link: https://ci/internal/12121/8

CI Bot: Job 12121.8 started on high-priority runners. Streaming logs: `Starting integ/shard-7`

(10m later)

CI Bot: Job 12121.8 passed all checks. Artifacts: https://ci/internal/12121/8/artifacts

Alex W: All green. Merging now. Thanks for the quick coordination everyone :tada:

Priya R: Thanks — I'll follow up on #458 to dig into the root cause and try to remove the retry later.

Sam: Nice one. If we see more shard backpressure we'll open an infra ticket to increase concurrency temporarily.

Taylor: FYI I bumped the per-queue limit for 30m just now to smooth the backlog.

CI Bot: Note: automatic cleanup will close temporary high-priority slot in 30m.

Alex W: Closing the loop here — merged and cherry-picked to release branch.
